Job Description As an AI Research Engineer at Bosch, you will explore a variety of real-world use cases that can significantly benefit from cutting-edge Large Language Models (LLMs), end-to-end trained ADAS systems, and AI agents. Your primary focus will be on developing efficient engineering and MLOps solutions that help tailor these models to specific Bosch applications, e.g., by fine-tuning generic language models using Bosch's proprietary data, and making them ready for use in industrial applications. You will collaborate closely with various corporate research departments and business units to identify and develop novel applications of AI technologies across Bosch's extensive product and service portfolio. You will leverage your entrepreneurial mindset to evaluate, develop, and pitch new ideas that can drive innovation within the organization. Furthermore, you will play a vital role in generating and securing intellectual property, e.g. through high-quality publications in leading AI journals and conferences. You will write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that supports both research initiatives and the transfer of technology to practical applications. You will shape and influence Bosch's technological development by assessing emerging machine learning technologies and providing strategic insights. Last but not least, you will work within a dynamic AI department alongside machine learning experts, collaborating with Bosch specialists globally to maximize business impact. You will also conduct experiments on both our on-premises GPU cluster and cloud infrastructure. Qualifications Education: excellent MSc in Computer Science or related fields, PhD in Machine Learning with focus on Large Language Models, generative AI or foundation models​​​​​ Experience and Knowledge: proven research track record and multiple years of hands-on expertise in LLMs, GenAI, agentic AI, end-2-end automotive models, or vision-language models, including publications in top machine learning conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR,...) deep familiarity with state-of-the-art agentic AI and LLM research, combined with the ability to translate this know-how into practical industrial applications extensive knowledge and experience in training, applying, evaluating, and adapting state-of-the-art foundation, large language (LLM), or vision-language (VLM) models within an industrial context (e.g., as part of an industrial AI team, or in academia working with large real-world datasets beyond academic benchmarks) excellent programming skills in Python with strong experience in Deep Learning frameworks like PyTorch, collaborative software development, and relevant deployment tools demonstrated proficiency in scalable machine learning architectures and distributed training (including multi-GPU/multi-node training), coupled with a strong drive to enable new applications and create an impact for Bosch Personality and Working Practice: you are a strong team player, highly self-motivated, and possess the conceptual strength and creativity to drive the spread of novel ideas and integrate the latest research solutions into Bosch products and services Languages: very good English skills written and spoken, German is a plus Additional Information https://www.bosch-ai.com www.bosch.com/research Please submit all relevant documents (CV, certificates, and links to GitHub or kaggle account). description_full: AI Research Scientist/Engineer (f/m/d) ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Sonar Bochum Vollzeit BALDIGER BEWERBUNGSSCHLUSS Auf diesen Job bewerben Position description At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Machine Learning Scientist to join our Data & AI team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis engine. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) techniques to the complex domain of source code. Your work will directly shape our products, pushing the boundaries of static analysis to help millions of developers write better, more secure code. If you are driven to solve real-world problems by turning state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you. What you will do Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay on the cutting edge of ML, Deep Learning, and LLMs, specifically their application to the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), and identify novel opportunities to enhance our products. Develop Advanced AI Models: Design, prototype, and validate novel ML models that identify and resolve complex bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells, going beyond the capabilities of traditional static analysis. Build LLM-Powered Features: Develop and implement advanced LLM-based solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for contextual code analysis, fine-tuning models on proprietary codebases, and exploring agentic systems for automated code remediation. Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale. Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful ML prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base. Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience and qualifications An advanced academic background (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. Strong industry experience in machine learning, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices and tools. Solid programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with core ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face). Familiarity with Java is a plus. Proven experience in applied Machine Learning, with a strong focus on Natural Language Processing (NLP) or, ideally, Programming Language Processing (PLP). Hands-on experience with modern LLM architectures and techniques, such as Fine-tuning strategies (e.g., LoRA, QLoRA), advanced prompt engineering, building and optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and working with vector databases and semantic search Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS). Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy. Excellent communication skills in English and a talent for explaining complex scientific topics clearly and concisely. Additional comments This role is based in Bochum. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch. The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application! Job Description As a research scientist in the semantic understanding and reasoning group (CR/AIR4) at Bosch Corporate Research, you will lead and advance research on intelligent AI systems that are able to take action, reason over goals and constraints, as well as organize knowledge through complex neuro-symbolic structures. Your work will focus on next-generation agentic systems that combine reinforcement learning, structured reasoning, memory, and knowledge-based representations to operate effectively in semantically rich also technically demanding environments. This role goes beyond individual technical contributions. You will contribute to shaping Bosch's scientific agenda in this area by identifying promising research directions, initiating and coordinating research activities, building connections to external academic and industrial partners, as well as representing Bosch in relevant research communities. You are expected to bring a strong external network and effectively position Bosch in collaborative projects, scientific exchanges, also strategic initiatives related to agentic AI, reinforcement learning, as well as neuro-symbolic systems. From a scientific perspective, you focus on developing systems that move from passive understanding toward goal‑directed behavior. You investigate how agents learn through interaction, simulation, and structured feedback, represent also manipulate knowledge in compositional forms, as well as integrate reinforcement learning with symbolic abstractions, hierarchical planning, memory, and reasoning. Your objective is to design systems that actively act while structuring knowledge to enable robust behavior, interpretability, also strong generalization. You will work closely with research scientists, engineers, students, as well as domain experts across Bosch. In addition to conducting high-level research, you will mentor students also junior researchers, actively shape and structure collaborative research activities, and contribute to the organizational development of this research area. Deine Kernaufgaben AI Use Cases & Lösungsentwicklung Du erkennst frühzeitig, wo KI und Automatisierung echten Mehrwert schaffen - für unsere Gäste, unsere Hotels, unsere internen Teams und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Konzepte. Du entwickelst und implementierst (Gen) AI- und LLM-basierte Anwendungen sowie KI-Agenten von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zum produktiven Einsatz. Du analysierst Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen, übersetzt sie in technische Lösungsansätze und begleitest den gesamten Projektzyklus vom Proof of Concept bis zum Go-live. Du hältst dich über aktuelle KI-Technologien und -Plattformen auf dem Laufenden und bringst neue Impulse aktiv ins Team ein. Prozessautomatisierung Du erkennst Automatisierungspotenziale in bestehenden Workflows und setzt diese strukturiert um – z.B. mit Power Automate oder Robotic Process Automation (RPA). Du entwickelst skalierbare Automatisierungslösungen in enger Abstimmung mit den betroffenen Bereichen und stellst deren Qualität sowie Stabilität sicher. Du dokumentierst Automatisierungsprozesse nachvollziehbar und sorgst für einen sauberen Übergang in den operativen Betrieb. Projektsteuerung & Enablement Du steuerst AI- und Automatisierungsprojekte eigenverantwortlich mit klarem Backlog, strukturierter Roadmap und agilen Methoden (Scrum/Kanban). Du entwickelst Entscheidungsvorlagen und präsentierst Ergebnisse adressatengerecht – auch auf Management-Ebene. Du treibst den Wissenstransfer rund um KI im Unternehmen aktiv voran. Du konzipierst Enablement-Formate, Workshops und interne Kommunikation, die Neugier wecken und Kompetenz aufbauen. Du bist die Brücke zwischen IT, Fachbereichen und externen Partnern – lösungsorientiert, kommunikationsstark und mit Blick auf den größtmöglichen Impact. Benefits: Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus. International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten. Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten. Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten. Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team. Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden. Qualifikationen Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium, z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, BWL oder vergleichbar Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit GenAI-Technologien, LLM-Plattformen oder KI-Agenten. Kenntnisse in Automatisierungstools (z.B. Power Automate, RPA) oder Cloud-Plattformen (z.B. Microsoft Azure) von Vorteil. Anwendung agiler Projektmethoden (Scrum/Kanban) und Backlog-Management. Begeisterung für die Hospitalitybranche und ein gutes Gespür für praxisnahe Lösungen sind ein Plus. Was wir erwarten Echte Leidenschaft für KI-Technologien sowie deren praktischen Einsatz im Unternehmensalltag. Analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise. Kommunikationsstärke – du kannst komplexe Technologie-Themen verständlich und begeisternd vermitteln. Lösungsorientiertes Mindset, hohe Eigeninitiative und Freude daran, Dinge wirklich umzusetzen. Teamgeist und Offenheit für interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit auf allen Unternehmensebenen. Mithilfe meiner Datenanalysen und Use-Case-Beschreibungen trage ich zum verlässlichen und transparenten Datenaustausch mit unseren externen und internen Kunden bei. Auf diese Weise leiste ich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum sicheren Systembetrieb, einem erfolgreichen Netzausbau durch 50Hertz und einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit. C1). Kein Muss, aber von Vorteil: * Kenntnisse im Requirements Engineering (Azure DevOps, Jira etc.) sowie einer Modellierungssprache (UML, BPMN oder C4) und UX-Design, * Anwendungserfahrung in Open-Source-Programmiersprachen wie Java, Python oder R und Robotic Process Automation (RPA) sowie Datenbankabfragen mit SQL, * Erfahrung als Key User*in oder Applikationsmanager*in von energiewirtschaftlichen Anwendungen (CRM-, EDM- und Abrechnungssystemen), * Markt- und Clearingprozesse zu Bilanzierungsverfahren mit fachspezifischer Kundenbetreuung zu MaBiS, GPKE und WiM, * Verständnis für Anforderungen zur Sicherstellung der Revisions- und Datensicherheit der Prozesse und eingesetzten Lösungen nach GoB, GoDV, DSGVO, GNDEW, * Beteiligung an Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten, Erfahrungen in Verbändearbeit, * Agile Scrum-Zertifizierung. Flexikompass – so flexibel ist diese Stelle: * Arbeitszeit: 37 Wochenstunden (Vollzeit), * Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Langzeitkonto zur Unterstützung Ihrer Work-Life-Balance, * Die Zahl der Gleittage ist nicht begrenzt, * Keine Kernarbeitszeit, * Mobiles Arbeiten (auch von zuhause) möglich. Als ÜNB übernehmen wir in gesell­schaftlicher, technischer und wirtschaftlicher Hinsicht eine zentrale Moderatoren­rolle bei der Verwirklichung der Energiewende. description_full: Executive Director, Operational Procurement ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Harman Becker Automotive Systems Manufacturing Kft Garching, Bavaria BALDIGER BEWERBUNGSSCHLUSS Auf diesen Job bewerben A Career at HARMAN As a technology leader that is rapidly on the move, HARMAN is filled with people who are focused on making life better. Innovation, inclusivity and teamwork are a part of our DNA. When you add that to the challenges we take on and solve together, you’ll discover that at HARMAN you can grow, make a difference and be proud of the work you do every day. About the Role In this role, you will lead the Operational Procurement team, tasked with building a robust and resilient material supply through an active engagement with HARMAN’s suppliers.  As a dynamic and visionary leader, you will fulfill multiple roles, including trail blazer, coach and advocate.  As the Operational Procurement leader, you will be responsible for driving supplier delivery performance outcomes through supplier engagement and development as well as early detection and resolution of supply issues.  You will build system and team capabilities required to successfully navigate the challenges associated with electronics supply chains.  Your operational mindset and exceptional leadership skills will be crucial in transforming HARMAN’s supply chain to meet the needs of an Automotive business on track to double our material supply requirements over the next 7 yrs. Your Team Your team consists of 50-60 team members with 5 to 6 direct reports. This position reports into the Senior Vice President, Procurement & BCA. What You Will Do Supply Coverage and Capacity Management: Engage HARMAN’s supply base to achieve material supply requirements, working across a 2-year time horizon. Confirm supply capacity commitments, including machine & tooling capacities. Drive closure of supply coverage gaps.  This includes active supplier engagement and facilitation of escalations as needed to achieve required outcomes. Actively manage HARMAN’s supply agreements to the required contractual performance outcomes. Supply Change and Exception Management: Drive and close the following in coordination with HARMAN’s suppliers: New product introduction (NPI) End-of-life (EOL) Part change notices (PCNs) and part termination notices (PTNs), including last time buys OEM customer volume increases and decreases Develop and implement efficient methods for identifying change driven exceptions that require active management into HARMAN’s supply base Master Data Management: Optimize existing methods and processes to ensure that HARMAN’s supplier relevant master data is continuously update and meeting the required quality Develop and deploy automated methods to update and maintain supplier relevant master data, including the use of robotic process automation (RPA) and supplier system integration (e.g., API access) Systems, Standards and Best Practices: Pilot and deploy systems/technologies enabling efficient use of internal resources and establishing collaborative work with HARMAN’s suppliers. Define and deploy KPIs that appropriately measure desired performance metrics and support the identification of performance gaps. Refine and optimize work processes to set clear standards and ways of working with both HARMAN’s suppliers and internal partners. Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration & Representation: Build a robust collaboration with SIOP and Manufacturing teams, ensuring that the organizations are working in concert to meet operational objectives Represent Procurement and HARMAN’s suppliers in the monthly consensus planning process Represent Procurement in executive level escalations, including executives from suppliers and/or HARMAN’s customers Develop Talent: Lead the development and growth of a high-performing Operational Procurement team. Provide coaching, mentorship, and training opportunities to enhance the capabilities of team members. Foster a culture of continuous learning, professional development, and innovation. Develop an ownership culture with team members empowered to solve problems and make decisions. What You Need Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or a relevant technical degree. Master's degree is preferred. 10+ years of relevant business experience in supplier facing roles.  Supply Chain Management experience is desired. Proven track record in leading and transforming functions to meet benchmark (top-quartile) performance levels. Prior experience in leading teams tasked with the management of multi-billion dollar supply delivery from a global network of suppliers. Demonstrated ability to drive required outcomes with large Automotive electronic component suppliers, including NXP, Texas Instruments, Renesas, Murata and Micron. Knowledge and expertise in the IT systems utilized to plan and communicate supply requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to leverage data to drive informed decisions

Wir sind Obungi – Spezialist für Data, Analytics und AI Cloud Solutions aus Hamburg und einer der TOP-Microsoft Partner in Deutschland! Seit 2006 realisieren wir Business Solutions mit dem Fokus auf cloudbasierte Data, Analytics & AI Lösungen. description_full: Sr Product Manager ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Dataiku Europe, Middle East, and Africa; France, Paris; France, Remote; Germany, Berlin - Munzstrasse 12; Germany, Remote; Netherlands, HOME-OFFICE BALDIGER BEWERBUNGSSCHLUSS Auf diesen Job bewerben Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack — empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance. The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. How you'll make an impact You will play a pivotal role in shaping Dataiku's product positioning, roadmap, and requirements for predictive analytics, machine learning, and GenAI under the responsibilities of the Director of Product Management in charge of Dataiku AI/ML offering. You will work with stakeholders across all parts of the business, including Engineering, Product, GTM, Partners, Marketing Operations, and Customer Success teams, to execute growth projects and new products and features. Your challenge is to identify and shape net new capabilities: innovations that are core additions to the product, discovered through deep customer engagement and validated before engineering commits. You are not here to maintain what exists in the long run, you will work with Technical Product Managers. You are here to find what's missing and make the case for building it. If you're ready to step into a role where your expertise leads to tangible, wide-scale impact, where every insight you gather shapes the future of our products, we're waiting for you! What you’ll be doing Embed with strategic customers to run structured discovery (interviews, async collaboration, or on-site visits) to surface unmet needs before they're obvious to competitors. Analyze usage and customer data to identify gaps and opportunities to enhance customer success and to deliver new capabilities with distinct business value propositions, ultimately contributing to the company's financial goals. Analyze market forces and competition, engage with industry analysts and Dataiku teams to execute on Dataiku’s product strategy. Collaborate with the Product Marketing team to align and deliver on product positioning messages. Build working prototypes (UI mockups, agentic pipeline demos, opportunity memos) to validate hypotheses with customers before engineering commits. Synthesize field signals across accounts to distinguish incremental customer requests from genuine innovation opportunities (net new capabilities that would be core additions to the platform.) Define and champion innovation initiatives from discovery through to launch, at which point ownership transitions to Technical Product Managers for ongoing improvements and maintenance. At launch, partner with Technical Product Managers to produce enablement material for internal customers (Product Marketing and GTM Enablement) ensuring new capabilities and big delighters land with the right positioning, messaging, and field readiness. Maintain the product backlog for the initiatives you own, constantly anticipating and aligning with the global product strategy and the software engineering delivery capacity. Participate in the development, maintenance and education on the AI/ML roadmap. Articulate your team’s technology vision, requirements, goals and milestones to stakeholders. description_full: AI & Data Science Analyst (all genders) ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Accenture Vienna, Borsegebaude Vollzeit HOME-OFFICE Auf diesen Job bewerben Job Description Im AI & Data Team bei Accenture vereinen wir einzigartige Persönlichkeiten und zukunftsgerichtetes Know-How, um gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden datengetriebene Transformation voranzutreiben und die Zukunft durch KI (Künstlichen Intelligenz) zu gestalten. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden Ende-zu-Ende – von der strategischen, KI-nativen Neuausrichtung & Zieldefinition der Organisation über die Konzeption & Entwicklung von cutting-edge KI-Lösungen bis hin zum technischen Design & der Implementierung von KI- & Daten-Plattformen. Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Expertise, moderne KI-Technologien (insb. generative und agentische KI) und tiefes Technologieverständnis, um messbaren, transformativen Geschäftswert zu schaffen. Deine Mission​ Du möchtest durch deine datengetriebene & analytische Denkweise, Problemlösungskompetenz und Affinität für moderne KI-Lösungen die spannendsten Herausforderungen verschiedener Industrien bewältigen? Dann bist du in der Data Science Practice genau richtig: Angesiedelt zwischen Strategy und Technology kombinieren wir Branchenerfahrung mit technischem Know-How, entwickeln innovative KI- und Data-Science-Lösungen und treiben die KI-Transformation unserer Kunden messbar voran. Dabei identifizierst du relevante Use Cases, setzt Lösungen vom Prototyp bis zur produktiven Anwendung um und siehst, wie deine Arbeit Unternehmen, Industrien und Menschenleben transformiert. Das erwartet dich Innovative, zukunftsgerichtete KI-Lösungen Setze deinen analytischen Verstand und dein kreatives Denken gezielt ein, um die nächste Generation von Data Science Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln und den Einsatz generativer und agentischer KI voranzutreiben. Wertschöpfung aus Daten Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams fokussierst du dich als Data Science Analyst darauf, Verbesserungs- und Wertsteigerungspotenziale zu identifizieren sowie zielgerichtete Analysen zu entwickeln und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass Daten wertschöpfend eingesetzt werden. Realer Impact für Industrien und Gesellschaft Bei Accenture arbeitest du mit weltweit führenden Unternehmen und Institutionen an wegweisenden Lösungen. Das Ziel: datengetriebene Anwendungsfälle identifizieren, gestalten, testen und erfolgreich in die Praxis bringen – von der ersten Idee bis zur Skalierung. So schaffst du echten Mehrwert und treibst Innovation voran. Implementierung kundenorientierter Lösungen In deiner Arbeit als Data Science Analyst stehst du mit den Entscheidungsträger:innen auf Kundenseite im engen Kontakt und sorgst dafür, dass die erarbeiteten KI-Lösungen in realen Umgebungen erfolgreich implementiert und skaliert werden. Darauf freuen wir uns Erfolgreicher Abschluss eines relevanten Studiums auf Master-Niveau in Fachrichtungen wie Physik, Mathematik, Informatik, Ingenieur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften Erste praktische Data Science-Erfahrung und Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Machine Learning, Deep Learning oder Reinforcement Learning Grundlegendes Verständnis im Bereich Generative KI (z.B. Retrieval-Augmented Generation/RAG); erste Erfahrungen mit agentischer KI und gängigen Frameworks wie LangChain oder LangGraph sind ein Plus Fundierte Programmierkenntnisse in Python, sowie Erfahrung mit gängigen Frameworks (z.B. Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) und im Bereich Datenaggregationen (z.B. SQL, Spark) Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse im Bereich Datenbanken (SQL-, NoSQL-, Vektor- oder Graphdatenbanken), BI und Visualization Tools (z.B. Tableau, Power BI oder Qlik), sowie Erfahrung mit Cloud Lösungen (z.B.
